audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is written as an unwinnable kite, but it never says where the range gap actually is, and it repeatedly credits Lillia with sustain she does not have.
audit.why: Winds of War reaches 825. Blooming Blows reaches 450, Watch Out! Eep! 500, Swirlseed 700 — Galio out-ranges every damaging tool Lillia owns, and only Lilting Lullaby (1600) reaches further.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is real but it is a damage-type problem, not a range problem: stand in the 825-to-700 gap and poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is described as a spike with no numbers, and the ultimate is treated as if it goes anywhere.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 with range 4000/4750/5500 and must be cast onto an ALLY. Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110.
audit.corrected: Spike framed as 'onto any ally within 4000 units' and her ult given its 150s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings claim Blooming Blows heals Lillia off its outer ring and call it 'her self-sustain'.
audit.why: Riot's description for Blooming Blows is move-speed stacking plus magic damage with extra TRUE damage on the edge. No ability in Lillia's kit carries a heal flag and no description mentions healing.
audit.corrected: Edge of Blooming Blows is true damage; the heal claim is removed everywhere it appeared.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states the condition on Lilting Lullaby.
audit.why: Riot: 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep.' Unmarked targets are not affected at all.
audit.corrected: Deny the Dream Dust mark and her 150-second ultimate cannot start on you — written into spikes[3], late and whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown breakdown tells you to track Blooming Blows before every punch.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 — it is never meaningfully down. Swirlseed is a flat 12s at every rank and is her only slow, so it is the cooldown that actually gates her.
audit.corrected: Track Swirlseed, not Blooming Blows; real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The loading line ends 'Anti-heal if he sustains' and the text leans on magic reduction as the answer.
audit.why: Lillia has no heal in her kit. Her Q edge is true damage and Dream-Laden Bough is max-health damage over time, so raw resistances are the wrong purchase.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal cue removed; buy health rather than stacked MR.

edits.before: Justice Punch (E) into Shield of Durand (W) is your only catch, but Lillia never commits — she pokes with Blooming Blows (Q), eats the heal off its outer ring, and jogs away on her passive movement speed before your taunt channel finishes.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) into Shield of Durand (W) is your only catch, but Blooming Blows (Q) reaches just 450 while Winds of War throws 825 — and its edge is TRUE damage, so no MR item answers it. Poke from that gap rather than chasing the taunt.

edits.before: Outer-ring poke with Blooming Blows (Q), eat the heal, and kite Galio's E dash on your passive movement speed so the taunt never lands
edits.after: Clip him with the Blooming Blows (Q) edge for true damage, then kite the Justice Punch dash on stacked move speed so his taunt never lands

edits.before: Hold Justice Punch (E) into Shield of Durand (W) and only commit the taunt when she actually steps onto the wave to last-hit — never blow it chasing
edits.after: Poke from the 825 range of Winds of War (Q) — her Q is 450, Eep! 500, Swirlseed 700, so the whole gap between those numbers is free damage

edits.before: She steps up with Blooming Blows (Q), heals off its outer ring and ticks Dream Dust on you; your single Q poke cannot out-trade her self-sustain.
edits.after: Blooming Blows (Q) reaches 450 and Winds of War throws 825; poke from that gap, because her edge damage is true and your MR cannot blunt it.

edits.before: Lillia never has to fight you straight, and that is the whole problem. Your Q tornado (Winds of War) pokes her, but Blooming Blows (Q) heals her off its outer ring and her Dream Dust passive ticks you while she keeps her distance. Do not throw Justice Punch (E) to chase — you whiff the dash, eat the burn for free, and she jogs off on the passive movement speed every Q proc grants her. Last-hit, hold Shield of Durand (W) for the one time she steps onto the wave, and accept that levels 1-3 are hers to kite.
edits.after: Lillia never has to fight you straight, and that is the whole problem. Winds of War (Q) throws 825 while Blooming Blows reaches 450, Watch Out! Eep! 500 and Swirlseed 700 — every damaging tool she owns is shorter than your poke, so stand in that gap and last-hit. What you cannot out-stat is the damage type: her Q edge is TRUE and Dream Dust ticks max health, so stacking MR buys you nothing. Do not throw Justice Punch (E) to chase — it stops on the first champion and a whiff leaves you 11 seconds with no escape.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay miserable: every time you E in she sidesteps and re-stacks the Dream Dust burn, and Shield of Durand only refunds magic damage AFTER she has already chunked you. Your real window is 6 — Hero's Entrance lets you ult to a sidelane or a fight she cannot reach, because that map presence is the only place you beat a Lillia who simply will not stand still for your taunt. Shove the wave with Winds of War (Q) and make value elsewhere instead of forcing a 1v1 you lose.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay miserable: Blooming Blows is a 6-second cooldown falling to 4, so there is no gap to wait out. The one cooldown worth counting is Swirlseed — a flat 12 seconds and her only slow — and the moment it rolls past you is your step-up. Your real window is 6: Hero's Entrance drops you onto any ally within 4000 units, and that map presence is the only place you beat a Lillia who will not stand still for the taunt. Shove with Winds of War and cash every crash sideways.

edits.before: She re-applies the Dream Dust burn every time you whiff an E dash chasing her, and your magic-reduction shield only refunds after she has already chunked you.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is back every 4 to 6 seconds, so there is nothing to wait out — the flat 12-second Swirlseed is the only cooldown of hers worth counting.

edits.before: Her R, Lilting Lullaby, sleeps you out of your own Hero's Entrance landing and sets up the team's burst — a teamfight problem your W taunt cannot reach because she casts it from max range.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (R, 150s at rank 1) only makes enemies already carrying Dream Dust drowsy — if she has not landed a spell on you first, her ultimate cannot sleep you at all. Arrive clean.

edits.before: Her R Lilting Lullaby sleeps you out of your own Hero's Entrance and her burn melts your tank-AP build — you peel and flank, you do not duel her.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust, so reach fights unmarked and her 150-second ultimate cannot even start on you.

edits.before: Late game she out-kites and out-tempos you. Her R, Lilting Lullaby, puts you to sleep the moment you drop out of Hero's Entrance, and her Liandry's plus Dream Dust burn melts your tank-AP build faster than Shield of Durand can refund. Your job is the front-to-back anchor: E-W to peel and taunt her off a carry, then ult to flank. Do not chase her solo — she sleeps you with R, kites the burn on her passive speed, and walks away every time.
edits.after: Late game she out-kites and out-tempos you, but her ultimate carries a condition: Lilting Lullaby only makes enemies already marked with Dream Dust drowsy, so if she has not landed a spell on you it cannot sleep you at all. Reach the fight clean. Her burn is max-health damage and her Q edge is true, so extra MR does nothing — buy raw health. Anchor front-to-back: E-W to peel her off a carry, then flank with Hero's Entrance.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Stick to her with E. Track it before every punch. - Your W: the trade-flipper — never burn it early. - Your R: a map-wide win condition — spend it on allies' fights.
edits.after: - Blooming Blows: 6s at rank 1, 4s maxed — far too short to wait out. - Swirlseed: a flat 12s and her only slow; the whiff is your step-up. - Lilting Lullaby: 150s, and it needs Dream Dust on you. - Your Justice Punch: 11s to 7s. - Your W: 18s.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. Stick to her with E. When it is down — Q-poke + punch the gap.
edits.after: Winds of War reaches 825; her Q is 450, Eep! 500, Swirlseed 700. Her Q edge is true damage, so MR is not the answer.

edits.before: - Galio vs Lillia - Track: Lillia Blooming Blows. - Punch only on its cooldown. - W is the trade-flipper, never burn it early. - Shove + R-roam from 6. - Anti-heal if he sustains.
edits.after: - Galio vs Lillia - Track: Swirlseed, a flat 12s. - Her Q edge is true damage — MR is no answer. - Poke from 825; she reaches 450. - Shove + R-roam from 6. - Reach fights unmarked.

edits.before: Lillia wins by landing Blooming Blows, punishing your E commit, and kiting your short range.
edits.after: Lillia wins by ticking max-health burn, dodging your punch, and sleeping you once Dream Dust is on.

edits.before: That is Lillia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The dash stops on the first champion; whiff it and you have 11 seconds of nothing.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance turns every ally fight on the map into a 2v1 — shove and look sideways. Reassess his ultimate too.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance lands on an ally within 4000 units — shove and look sideways. Her 150s ult needs Dream Dust on you.

edits.before: Your shield eats his magic — trade Q + Colossal Smash when Blooming Blows is down. Galio wins the Blooming Blows cooldown windows.
edits.after: Poke from 825 where she reaches 450, and buy health over MR — her Q edge is true damage and Dream Dust burns max health.

notes: Biggest error: four strings credited Lillia with a heal off the outer ring of Blooming Blows. Riot's description gives that edge extra TRUE damage, and no ability in her kit carries a heal flag or mentions healing — the advice was telling a Galio player to expect sustain that does not exist while missing the reason his MR build underperforms. Second: nothing recorded the condition on Lilting Lullaby, which only affects enemies already carrying Dream Dust. The range gap (Galio Q 825 vs her 450/500/700) was absent everywhere and is the concrete reason the lane is playable. FULL layer calls Lillia 'he/his' throughout; corrected only in the strings I touched.
